directives.necessity: The import runs benchbox.cli.platform_defaults only for its module-level platform hook registrations; the imported name is otherwise unused.
directives.alternative: Have the entrypoint call an explicit registration function; platform_defaults has none today, so that is an executable change.

directives.necessity: ast.NodeVisitor dispatches on method names such as visit_AsyncFunctionDef and visit_ImportFrom, and the two aliases must keep those mixed-case names.
directives.alternative: Define both methods explicitly and delegate to visit_FunctionDef and visit_Import, which removes the suppression.
directives.removal_trigger: The aliases are replaced by delegating methods.

directives.necessity: _validate_semantic_surfaces exceeds the cyclomatic complexity limit; this is a discretionary suppression.
directives.alternative: Split the function into one validator per semantic surface.
directives.removal_trigger: The function is split below the complexity limit.

obligations.blocking_disposition: The trigger condition appears met. The shared-infrastructure owner decides whether to drop the guard; deleting the comment alone earns no credit.

review_dispositions.rationale: Resolve notices in derived first-party material by provenance and governing requirement; no blanket SPDX substitution or legal prose exception.
acceptance_refs: Notice/provenance ledger resolves first-party derived material and upstream exceptions individually, with governing requirement and retained bytes; no wholesale legal or vendor-directory carve-out.

review_dispositions.rationale: Migrate Click, FastMCP, argparse, API, display, and known runtime __doc__ consumers before removing producers.
acceptance_refs: Benchmark-list runtime descriptions use existing canonical registry data before any benchmark class docstring removal. All other cross-module consumers have migrated or have a verified consumer-before-producer dependency; local consumers are explicitly owned.

review_dispositions.rationale: Inventory source-text guards, delimiters, and parsed output records while preserving meaningful rejected and nonempty cases.
acceptance_refs: Comment-based workflow/Make extraction tests use stable structural/executable boundaries, preserving the original fragment and rejected trust behavior; no test becomes vacuous.

review_dispositions.rationale: Sphinx rendering alone is insufficient; useful per-interface reference content must precede source deletion.
acceptance_refs: Generated reference pages retain useful signatures, parameter/default distinctions, behavior, errors and examples; deliberate removal of filler/false claims is recorded and public facade forwarding remains intact.

review_dispositions.rationale: Accept raw SQL and ledger identity risk, but reject a permanent exemption for explanatory SQL; disclose payload identity by slice without normalization or historical-result rewriting.
acceptance_refs: Source-only slices pass narrow executable parity and byte-identical SQL/data/output-input comparisons. SQL/output identity changes use separately disclosed payload batches with raw-hash, non-comment token/order/parameter/hint and relevant correctness/plan/timing evidence; historical bundles and identity algorithms are not rewritten.

review_dispositions.rationale: Unsupported claims are scheduled for deletion; TPC-H compliance assurance and false TPC-DS equivalence claims must disappear, not relocate as provenance.
acceptance_refs: Existing TTT cursor-counting and seed/parameter tests remain effective; generated output consumers accept explicit provenance without unsupported assurance, with raw identity migration disclosed.

review_dispositions.rationale: Evaluate every legacy TPC-DS power, runner, throughput, and DataFrame caller and global RNG effect; ordering, parameters, RNG, and timing changes require a separate migration.
acceptance_refs: Approved/no-change/rejected disposition is explicit. Any accepted algorithm change waits for later authorization and separate scoped implementation; source-only cleanup remains unchanged.

review_dispositions.rationale: Repair active references while rejecting rewrites of historical snapshots, counts, and SHA citations.
acceptance_refs: All required knowledge/TODO obligations and active navigation have reviewed owning destinations; unsupported claims are gone, and historical citations/baselines/result bundles are unchanged.

review_dispositions.rationale: Require exact per-language directive grammar, minimal syntax, stable exception identity, owner and trigger, while acknowledging static limits on dynamic prose and simplicity.
acceptance_refs: Exceptions remain precise and provenance-bound; no blanket prefix, directory, file or 'fixture' exemptions; permanent interpreter requirements are not arbitrarily expired.
Checker limits are explicit: it does not prove simplicity, legal permission, arbitrary dynamic prose absence or benchmark equivalence.

review_dispositions.rationale: Include compiler references, Vitest environments, formatting, and ignore or coverage controls without wider waivers.
acceptance_refs: All owned maintained configuration/workflows lose discretionary comments and generator reintroduction; relevant policy prose is external and no lint/type/coverage gate is weakened.

review_dispositions.rationale: Replace sole-docstring bodies with pass only where required; executable comparison must not ignore arbitrary strings or control flow.
acceptance_refs: Python comparison rejects all executable drift except exactly specified removal and empty-body repair; unrelated strings and controls are never normalized away.

review_dispositions.rationale: Refresh volume and classification, then choose measured file, PR, review, and CI budgets before broad cleanup; independent soundness and native review remain required.
acceptance_refs: Concrete module file/batch/PR/reviewer/CI budget is selected and recorded from pilot evidence before broad deletion; estimated counts are not delivery commitments. Pause and revise the plan if the agreed scope, cost limit or required reviews cannot be met. Existing implementation authorization is not requested again.

review_dispositions.rationale: Map invariants to effective tests, including timed cursor counting and all-chunk CRLF carry; add only demonstrated gaps such as joined-slot replacement races.
acceptance_refs: Concurrency coverage rejects publication/replacement violations; reuse existing tests and add a deterministic race case only if a real gap is demonstrated.

review_dispositions.rationale: Investigate exact missing counts versus lookup failures and publication; preserve current SKIP and warning behavior without endorsing fail-open policy.
acceptance_refs: Current verdict/warning/publication behavior is traced across intentional absence, lookup miss, known expectations, mismatch, failure and timeout; callers and contracts are named.

review_dispositions.rationale: Remove the private expected-results wrapper only after direct and dynamic-use proof, preserving the actual loader and historical classification record.
acceptance_refs: Direct, dynamic, reflection/plugin and public-contract use is checked at the current head. Disposition is removal only if genuinely unused; otherwise document the demonstrated retention requirement externally.

review_dispositions.rationale: Assess existing DataFusionExpr typing at the deferred filter boundary; preserve filter build behavior and lazy imports without blind casts or wrappers.
acceptance_refs: Actual caller/dispatch, existing TYPE_CHECKING DataFusionExpr and sibling implementation establish a concrete type change or no-change disposition; Any is not justified by prose alone.

review_dispositions.rationale: Remove obsolete interrogate and badge consumers and regenerate the current Make inventory, without rewriting historical baselines or proofs.
acceptance_refs: Interrogate configuration, both hardcoded gate consumers, Make public target/help behavior and docs workflow badge are reconciled atomically with meaningful replacement validation.
Current Make inventory regenerates through the supported entrypoint; historical monolith baseline/migration evidence is byte-preserved and any current receipt diff is explained.

review_dispositions.rationale: Consumer and generator migrations precede deletion; each batch must prove completed prerequisites and owning destinations.
acceptance_refs: Consumer→producer ordering covers cross-module runtime/source-test reads, not only directory ownership: either the prerequisite migrates the reader or an explicit dependency blocks producer deletion.
Implementation and parallel-write authorization boundaries, ownership freeze, shared test lock and independent PR/review requirements are written into the dispatch contract.
